verses.en: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.pt: Adão, Sete, Enos,
verses.en_web: Adam, Seth, Enosh,
verses.en_bbe: Adam, Seth, Enosh;

verses.en: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.pt: Quenã, Maalalel, Jarede,
verses.en_web: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
verses.en_bbe: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

verses.en: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.pt: Enoque, Matusalém, Lameque,
verses.en_web: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.en_bbe: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;

verses.en: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.pt: Noé, Sem, Cão e Jafé.
verses.en_web: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.en_bbe: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.en: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Jafé: Gomer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tiras.
verses.en_web: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.

verses.en: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Gomer: Asquenaz, Rifate e Togarma.
verses.en_web: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.

verses.en: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Dodanim.
verses.en_web: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.

verses.en: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Cão: Cuche, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.

verses.en: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Cuche: Seba, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá; e os filhos de Raamá: Sebá e Dedã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.en: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.pt: Cuche foi pai de Ninrode, o qual foi o primeiro a ser poderoso na terra:
verses.en_web: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And Cush was the father of Nimrod: he was the first to be a great man in the earth.

verses.en: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Napthtuhim,
verses.pt: De Mizraim descenderam os ludeus, os anameus, os leabeus, os naftueus,
verses.en_web: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,
verses.en_bbe: And Egypt was the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim

verses.en: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.pt: os patrusins, os casluins (dos quais procederam os filisteus) e os caftoreus.
verses.en_web: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.
verses.en_bbe: And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim (from whom came the Philistines).

verses.en: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.pt: Canaã foi pai de Sidom, seu primogênito, e de Hete,
verses.en_web: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,
verses.en_bbe: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,

verses.en: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.pt: e dos jebuseus, dos amorreus, dos girgaseus,
verses.en_web: the Jebusite, and the Amorite, the Girgashite,
verses.en_bbe: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,

verses.en: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.pt: dos heveus, dos arqueus, dos sineus,
verses.en_web: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,
verses.en_bbe: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,

verses.en: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.pt: dos arvadeus, dos zemareus e dos hamateus.
verses.en_web: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.en_bbe: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.

verses.en: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Sem: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude, Arã, Uz, Hul, Geter e Meseque.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.

verses.en: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.pt: Arfaxade foi pai de Selá; e Selá foi pai de Eber.
verses.en_web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.
verses.en_bbe: And Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

verses.en: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.pt: A Eber nasceram dois filhos: o nome dum foi Pelegue, pois nos seus dias se repartiu a terra; e o nome do seu irmão foi Joctã.
verses.en_web: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.en_bbe: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days a division was made of the earth; and his brother's name was Joktan.

verses.en: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.pt: Joctã foi pai de Almodá, Selefe, Hazarmavé, Jerá,
verses.en_web: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,
verses.en_bbe: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah

verses.en: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.pt: Hadorão, Uzal, Diclá,
verses.en_web: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,
verses.en_bbe: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah

verses.en: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.pt: Ebal, Abimael, Sebá,
verses.en_web: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,
verses.en_bbe: And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba

verses.en: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.pt: Ofir, Havilá e Jobabe; todos esses foram filhos de Joctã.
verses.en_web: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.en_bbe: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

verses.en: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.pt: Sem, Arfaxade, Selá;
verses.en_web: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
verses.en_bbe: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

verses.en: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.pt: Eber, Pelegue, Reú;
verses.en_web: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.en_bbe: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.en: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.pt: Serugue, Naor, Tera;
verses.en_web: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.en_bbe: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.en: Abram; the same is Abraham.
verses.pt: Abrão, que é Abraão.
verses.en_web: Abram (also called Abraham).
verses.en_bbe: Abram (that is Abraham).

verses.en: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Abraão: Isaque e Ismael.
verses.en_web: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

verses.en: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.pt: Estas são as suas gerações: o primogênito de Ismael, Nebaiote; depois Quedar, Adbeel, Mibsão,
verses.en_web: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.en_bbe: These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,

verses.en: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.pt: Misma, Dumá, Massá, Hadade, Tema,
verses.en_web: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,
verses.en_bbe: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,

verses.en: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.pt: Jetur, Nafis e Quedemá; esses foram os filhos de Ismael.
verses.en_web: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.en_bbe: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

verses.en: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.pt: Quanto aos filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão, esta deu à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Isbaque e Suá. Os filhos de Jocsã foram Sebá e Dedã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's servant-wife: she was the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

verses.en: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Efer, Hanoque, Abidá e Eldá; todos esses foram filhos de Quetura.
verses.en_web: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

verses.en: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.pt: Abraão foi pai de Isaque. Os filhos de Isaque: Esaú e Israel.
verses.en_web: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

verses.en: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeús, Jalão e Corá.
verses.en_web: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.

verses.en: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Elifaz: Temã, Omar, Zefi, Gatã, Quenaz, Timna e Amaleque.
verses.en_web: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.

verses.en: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá.
verses.en_web: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.

verses.en: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezar, and Dishan.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Seir: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Anás, Disom, Eser e Disã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.

verses.en: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Lotã: Hori, e Homã; e a irmã de Lotã foi Timna.
verses.en_web: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.

verses.en: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Sobal: Aliã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefi e Onã. Os filhos de Zibeão: Aías e Anás.
verses.en_web: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

verses.en: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.pt: Anás foi pai de Disom. Os filhos de Disom: Hanrão, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.
verses.en_web: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.

verses.en: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã e Jaacã. Os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.
verses.en_web: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.en: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.pt: Estes foram os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que houvesse rei sobre os filhos de Israel: Belá, filho de Beor; e era o nome da sua cidade Dinabá.
verses.en_web: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom, before there was any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his town was named Dinhabah.

verses.en: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Belá, e reinou em seu lugar Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.
verses.en_web: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.

verses.en: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Jobabe, e reinou em seu lugar Husão, da terra dos temanitas.
verses.en_web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.

verses.en: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.pt: Morreu Husão, e reinou em seu lugar Hadade, filho de Bedade, que derrotou os midianitas no campo de Moabe; e era o nome da sua cidade Avite.
verses.en_web: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his town was named Avith.

verses.en: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Hadade, e reinou em seu lugar Sâmela, de Masreca.
verses.en_web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.

verses.en: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Sâmela, e reinou em seu lugar Saul, de Reobote junto ao rio.
verses.en_web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,

verses.en: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Saul, e reinou em seu lugar Baal-Ranã, filho de Acbor.
verses.en_web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.

verses.en: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.pt: Morreu Baal-Hanã, e Hadade reinou em seu lugar; e era o nome da sua cidade Paí. O nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.
verses.en_web: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai: and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his town was named Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

verses.en: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.pt: E morreu Hadade. Os príncipes de Edom foram: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Aliá, o príncipe Jetete,
verses.en_web: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,
verses.en_bbe: And Hadad came to his end. Now the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,

verses.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.pt: o príncipe Aolíbama, o príncipe Elá, o príncipe Pinom,
verses.en_web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.en_bbe: The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,

verses.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.pt: o príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,
verses.en_web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.en_bbe: The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,

verses.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
verses.pt: o príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe lrã. Estes foram os príncipes de Edom.
verses.en_web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
verses.en_bbe: The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
